claims.text: All normal: extensive further testing (CT, MRI) is not recommended; follow-up evaluation with a weight measurement in about 1 month.
claims.quote: If all test results are normal and clinical findings are otherwise normal, extensive further testing (eg, CT, MRI) is not recommended. Such testing is very low yield and can be misleading and harmful by revealing incidental, unrelated findings. Such patients should be taught how to ensure adequate caloric intake and have a follow-up evaluation in approximately 1 month that includes a weight measurement.

claims.text: Weight loss continues with otherwise normal findings: then consider CT or MRI.
claims.quote: If weight loss continues and all other findings remain normal, further testing (eg, CT, MRI) should be considered.
